item.title: Over-the-Toilet Storage: Measure Clearance Before Choosing Shelves
item.description: The wall above a toilet can hold useful storage in a small bathroom, but it is also an easy place to install the wrong shelf. A unit can fit the wall and still block the tank lid, crowd the person sitting below it or make a service panel hard to reach. Measure the toilet and the storage together. The goal is not to fill every inch above the tank, but to add a small amount of reachable storage without interfering with normal use or maintenance.
